items.vignette: At a fictional school-board meeting, a speaker says: "Everyone who genuinely cares about students supports Plan P."
items.independent_evidence: No factual evidence for Plan P is supplied.
questions: Identify the exact social or identity cue in the quoted message. State the claim and any missing warrant.
What social/identity or motivational mechanisms are plausible? Give at least one alternative explanation and indicate what remains unknown.
Assess the argument's evidential support without inferring the speaker's intention or a listener's actual mental state.
What evidence would make you revise your conclusion? Give pre-feedback confidence as a number from 0 to 100.
items.instructional_goal: Identify moral-identity framing without equating the cue with proven manipulation or an observed psychological response.
